study type: Retrospective Cross-sectional study using registry data
cohort: The study included data from children with all types of disability born between 2004 and 2018 in Baoan District, Shenzhen, and compared their perinatal information with the whole registered population of live births in the district.
finding: The overall prevalence of children's disability in Baoan district was 1.02% over 15 years, declining after specific policy engagement, with mental and intelligent disabilities remaining the most common types.
mod_finding: The percentage of children born by cesarean section was higher among disabled children compared to the whole population of live births.
birth_weight: All birth weights, with specific mention of low birth weight infants
gest_age: All gestational ages, with specific mention of premature infants
